definitions.explanation: The period of heavy traffic and crowded transportation that occurs when large numbers of people travel to their hometowns during major holidays such as New Year, Obon, and Golden Week.

examples.japanese: {帰省|きせい}ラッシュ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧だ。
examples.english: The bullet train is fully booked because of the homecoming rush.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰省|きせい}ラッシュ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: We left early to avoid the Obon homecoming rush.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰省|きせい}ラッシュ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧になった。
examples.english: During the year-end/New Year homecoming rush, the expressway had a 30-kilometer traffic jam.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan experiences major {帰省|きせい}ラッシュ periods three times a year: ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧ (New Year), ⟦ゴールデンウィーク→ゴールデンウィーク：22760_goorudenwiiku⟧ (Golden Week in May), and ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ (mid-August). During these periods, highways develop massive traffic jams and train tickets sell out quickly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帰省|きせい}ラッシュ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピーク→ピーク：11174_piiku⟧ (peak of the homecoming rush)
- {帰省|きせい}ラッシュ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid the homecoming rush)
- Uターン⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧ (the return rush — traffic heading back to the cities after holidays)
